name: Sea Breeze Beach House
accommodation: One-bedroom studio with a double bed
beachAccess: About a six-minute walk to Manorbier beach and the coast path
confirmedFeatures: Kitchenette, en suite shower, wood burner, pocket-sprung double bed, smart TV, Wi-Fi, bi-fold doors onto a patio with table and chairs and sun loungers, barbecue and picnic hamper, south-facing enclosed walled garden with a sedum roof, body boards, welcome pack
overview: Sea Breeze is an architect-designed eco studio with a sedum roof in Manorbier village, about six minutes' walk from the beach and three from the castle. It has a double bed, a kitchenette, a wood burner and a private walled garden. The owner says it is open from March to September each year, with rates from £120 in low season (two-night minimum) and £150 in August (four-night minimum). The village pub serves food and has music evenings most weekends.
surfTripFit: A walk to the beach and body boards provided make it an easy couple's base for Manorbier, with Freshwater West also within reach.
verificationNote: Details from the property's own website, Visit Pembrokeshire and the owner's reply of 12 November 2026. Surfbooker has not stayed here; confirm facilities and policies directly when you enquire.
